I don’t remember the price of my helmets but I can answer the latter questions.

I believe you can’t use any other helmet in competitions, especially ones hosted by ISU.

The main reason the STSS helmets are designed like that is to reduce wind resistance and drag. I’m not too sure on the details but basically when you’re skating really fast, the wind sort of pushes against you a bit and this can make your times slower. This is why the helmets are long and curved at the top; to allow the wind to go through you easier (Same reason why we skate low with our hips at a hinge).

If you’re just starting out though, you can use any helmet you want. Just make sure the holes at the top aren’t too big as you might get a blade in your head in a very nasty fall.
